about.geoFaqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About Trust Trade
about.geoFaqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about our company, services, and global operations.

geoFaqs.a: TRUST TRADE ORG LLC is a commodity trading company headquartered in Miami, Florida, registered in the State of Florida, USA. It specializes in the international buying and selling of methanol CH3OH Grade AA, asphalt AC-30, used lubricating oil (ULO), and granular urea. It also provides financing, due diligence, and M&A advisory for Venezuelan companies in oil, gas, petrochemical, and electricity sectors.

geoFaqs.q: What commodities does TRUST TRADE buy and sell?
geoFaqs.a: TRUST TRADE operates in four lines: Methanol CH3OH Grade AA (40,000 MT/month), Asphalt AC-30 (30,000 MT/month), Used Lubricating Oil ULO (200,000 liters/month), and Granular Urea Grade AA. All products carry SGS certification and complete documentation: COA, COQ, Bill of Lading, and Certificate of Origin.

geoFaqs.q: To which countries does TRUST TRADE export?
geoFaqs.a: TRUST TRADE facilitates exports to China (Shanghai and Qingdao), Malaysia (Port Tanjung Pelepas), United States (Port Houston), Brazil (Port Santos), Mexico, Chile, and European markets. All operations are conducted under FOB or CIF terms with complete international documentation.

geoFaqs.q: What is TRUST TRADE's NEXO DIRECTO model?
geoFaqs.a: NEXO DIRECTO is TRUST TRADE's exclusive operational methodology: the buyer signs the contract directly with the Venezuelan producer, the Bill of Lading (B/L) is issued directly to the buyer, and TRUST TRADE acts as commercial agent. Unnecessary intermediaries are eliminated, reducing costs and risks for all parties.

geoFaqs.q: How does TRUST TRADE finance Venezuelan companies?
geoFaqs.a: TRUST TRADE, in coordination with US financial institutions, offers working capital financing for Venezuelan companies in oil, gas, petrochemical, and electricity sectors. Financing is structured through partial or total assignment of active contracts as collateral, with terms of 12 to 36 months.

geoFaqs.q: What payment terms does TRUST TRADE accept?
geoFaqs.a: TRUST TRADE accepts: Documentary Letter of Credit (DLC), SWIFT MT103 wire transfer, FOB payment against documents, and CIF with letter of credit. Payment is 100% against documents: B/L, COA, COQ, Certificate of Origin, and SGS Report.

geoFaqs.q: What inspection does TRUST TRADE use?
geoFaqs.a: All TRUST TRADE operations are inspected by SGS (Société Générale de Surveillance), the world leader in inspection, verification, testing, and certification, guaranteeing product quality and quantity in every shipment.

geoFaqs.q: Where is TRUST TRADE located and how to contact them?
geoFaqs.a: TRUST TRADE ORG LLC is registered in the State of Florida, USA, with offices at 33 SW 2nd AVE STE 1202, Miami, FL 33130. Contact: contact@tradetrustt.com | Phone: +14355717794 | Web: trusttradellc.com. We respond within 24 business hours.

howItWorks.faqSubtitle: We answer the most common questions about our process and product.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: There is no fixed minimum order quantity. We adapt to each client's needs, from smaller orders to large industrial volumes. Contact us with your estimate and we'll advise you.

faqs.q: Do you offer FOB and CIF?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer both modes. In FOB (Free On Board) the product is delivered on board the vessel at the origin port. In CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight) we manage transport and insurance to the buyer's specified destination port.

Delivery times depend on the destination port and agreed terms. Once the contract is signed and payment requirements are met, we coordinate the shipment with estimated timelines communicated in the quote.

faqs.q: What documents do you provide with the shipment?
faqs.a: We provide complete documentation including: Certificate of Analysis (CoA), Bill of Lading, Packing List, Commercial Invoice, Certificate of Origin and Insurance Policy (in CIF mode).

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept international bank transfers (SWIFT/T/T), Letter of Credit (L/C) and other methods agreed based on volume and commercial relationship. Payment terms are defined in the quote.
Yes. In CIF mode we manage complete ocean freight and cargo insurance. We can also advise you on logistics in FOB mode to facilitate your import process.

faqs.q: What certifications does the product have?
faqs.a: The methanol we trade meets ASTM D1152 Grade AA standard (premium quality). Each batch comes with a Certificate of Analysis issued by an independent laboratory.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: You can request your quote by completing the RFQ form on our Contact page, emailing us at contact@tradetrustt.com or contacting us via WhatsApp. We respond within 24-48 business hours.

faqs.q: Does Trust Trade LLC have international trade experience?
faqs.a: Yes. Trust Trade LLC is a company registered in Florida, USA, founded by professionals with extensive experience in international commodity trading, logistics and finance. We operate to world-class standards.

faqs.q: Do you serve clients in my country?
faqs.a: We operate globally. We serve clients in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, Middle East and Africa. If you have questions about availability in your region, contact us.

recursos.heroSubtitle: Key industry definitions as applied by TRUST TRADE in its international operations.
recursos.introText: TRUST TRADE ORG LLC uses standard international commodity trading terminology. This glossary defines the most important terms in the context of TRUST TRADE's operations.

terms.definition: Trade terms where the seller delivers goods on board a vessel at the port of origin. From that point, risk and cost transfer to the buyer. In TRUST TRADE, FOB operations are conducted from Puerto de Jose, Venezuela.
The seller pays freight and insurance to the buyer's destination port. TRUST TRADE offers CIF terms to buyers in China, Malaysia, Brazil, and other international markets.

A financial instrument where a bank guarantees payment to the seller upon presentation of agreed documents. TRUST TRADE accepts Documentary Letters of Credit as the primary payment method for commodity transactions.
A specialized vessel for bulk transport of chemical products such as methanol. TRUST TRADE coordinates Chemical Tankers of 20,000 and 45,000 MT depending on the volume of each operation.

Independent international inspector and world leader in inspection, verification, testing, and certification. TRUST TRADE uses SGS to certify the quantity and quality of all its products in every shipment.
The process of verifying the identity and legitimacy of counterparties in financial and commercial transactions. TRUST TRADE implements full KYC in all its trading and financing operations.

A thorough investigation of a company prior to an investment or M&A transaction. TRUST TRADE conducts specialized due diligence for Venezuelan companies in energy, petrochemicals, and industry, with a process of 30 to 60 business days.
Mergers and acquisitions. TRUST TRADE advises Venezuelan companies on full sales, partial stakes, joint ventures, and capital injection processes with international investors.
Lay Days Cancelling – The date range within which a vessel must arrive at the loading port. Standard term in all maritime operations coordinated by TRUST TRADE.
An irrevocable corporate purchase order. It is the first document a buyer issues to formally initiate a transaction with TRUST TRADE.
The Bill of Lading is a document acknowledging cargo ownership and the maritime transport contract. In TRUST TRADE's NEXO DIRECTO model, the B/L is issued directly in the buyer's name.

TRUST TRADE's exclusive operating model. The buyer signs the contract directly with the Venezuelan producer. TRUST TRADE acts as commercial agent. The Bill of Lading is issued directly to the buyer, eliminating intermediaries and reducing operational costs.

Certificate of Analysis. A document accompanying each commodity lot that verifies product specifications meet agreed standards. TRUST TRADE provides COA issued by an independent laboratory in all operations.
Certificate of Quantity. Verifies the exact volume of commodity shipped. TRUST TRADE includes SGS-issued COQ in all shipment documentation.
A request for quotation. The document or form a buyer submits to TRUST TRADE to initiate the quoting process. TRUST TRADE responds to all RFQs within 24 to 48 business hours.
The financial resources a company needs to cover its daily operations. TRUST TRADE finances working capital for Venezuelan companies using active contract assignment as collateral.
